jobs.occupation: Sous Chef at Lovund Hotel – Help shape the flavours of the Helgeland Coast
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about food and creating exceptional guest experiences? Do you want to help develop and shape the culinary identity of one of Norway’s most unique hotels? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Hva vi ser etter

We are looking for someone who is passionate about great flavours, respects ingredients and wants to develop both people and culinary concepts. You are confident in your craft, creative and organised, and you thrive just as much on leading a team through a busy service as you do on developing next season's menu.

• 

Hold a professional qualification as a chef, preferably with experience as a Sous Chef or in another kitchen leadership role

• 

Have a strong interest in locally sourced and sustainable food

• 

Be quality-conscious, organised and solution-oriented

• 

Be a team player who motivates others and creates a sense of confidence and security

• 

Be flexible and thrive in a fast-paced seasonal environment

• 

Have good communication skills in Norwegian or English

• 

Have experience working with fresh fish and shellfish

Lovund may be small on the map. Our ambitions are much bigger.

Would you like to make your mark on our kitchen? We would love to hear from you -- even if you are not actively looking for a new job today.

Send us a few words about yourself, your experience and what you dream of developing as a chef and leader.

Arbeidsoppgaver

• 

Contribute to menu planning and development in collaboration with the Head Chef

• 

Shift leader during evening service

• 

Preparation and production of dinners and banqueting

• 

Plan and coordinate the daily allocation of tasks

• 

Ensure quality control throughout food production

• 

Manage goods handling and stock control, including some ordering of supplies

• 

Supervise, support and train employees and apprentices

• 

Ensure smooth service and effective teamwork during service

• 

Maintain and develop strong health, safety and food hygiene routines, including HSE and food safety procedures

Vi tilbyr

• 

A key role in the development of the kitchen and culinary concept.

• 

The opportunity to work with high-quality ingredients sourced from the sea and the Helgeland coast.

• 

Responsibility and influence over day-to-day operations.

• 

A dedicated team with ambitions to create exceptional experiences for our guests and make the most of what the destination has to offer.

• 

Opportunities for professional development and assistance with accommodation by mutual agreement.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Lovund Hotell ligger spektakulært til ved havet på øya Lovund, midt i hjertet av Helgelandskysten. Vi er kjent for vår varme gjestfrihet, moderne uttrykk og høy kvalitet i både service og matopplevelse. Hotellets restaurant tilbyr nordnorsk matkultur med fokus på lokale råvarer fra hav og land, og vi jobber kontinuerlig med å løfte vårt kjøkken til nye høyder.

jobs.occupation: Radiologist position at Skien Hospital in Telemark
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced radiologist seeking a new professional challenge in Norway? We are looking for a dedicated radiologist to join the team at Skien Hospital, a part of the Telemark Hospital Trust.
Skien Hospital is the main facility of the Telemark Hospital Trust, serving as the central hospital for Telemark County. The hospital offers a wide range of medical services, including a well-equipped radiology department that provides diagnostic imaging and interventional procedures. The radiology department is known for its collaborative environment and commitment to high-quality patient care.

 

Responsibilities

• Interpret and report on MRI, CT, ultrasound and conventional X-ray examinations.
• Perform biopsies and interventional radiology procedures.
• Participate in interdisciplinary meetings and collaborate with other departments.
• Provide training and supervision to resident doctors.
Qualifications

• Medical license and radiology specialty certification from an EU/EEA country.
• Broad experience in diagnostic radiology, including MRI, CT, ultrasound and interventional procedures.
• Proficient in English and motivated to learn Norwegian. A free language course will be provided.
Personal qualities

• Passionate about radiology and patient care.
• Strong teamwork and communication skills.
• Ability to work independently and adapt to new environments.
• High work capacity and dedication to continuous learning.
What Skien Hospital offers

• A supportive and friendly working environment.
• A department focused on quality and continuous development.
• Access to modern medical equipment and facilities.
• Competitive salary and benefits, including pension and insurance schemes.
Additional benefits from Dignus Medical

• Free online language course with a private tutor.
• Assistance with obtaining Norwegian medical authorization and specialist approvals.
• Relocation support for you and your family, including help with accommodation and travel arrangements.
• Ongoing career guidance and support throughout the recruitment process.
About Skien

 

Located in the heart of Telemark County, Skien is one of Norway’s oldest cities, with a rich history dating back to the Middle Ages. The city is renowned as the birthplace of playwright Henrik Ibsen and offers a vibrant cultural scene, including theaters, galleries and music festivals. Skien is surrounded by beautiful nature, providing ample opportunities for outdoor activities such as hiking, skiing and boating. The city has a population of approximately 55,000 and is well-connected, with Oslo just 1.5 hours away by car or train.

 

If radiology is your passion and you’re ready to embark on a new adventure in Norway, we would love to hear from you!

 

You can also register your CV or sign up for our newsletter to stay updated on future opportunities.

 

'

Watch our anniversary film and join us on our journey!

jobs.occupation: Permanent nursing positions in Jondal, Norway
jobs.description: On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Jondal, Western Norway.You will work across both nursing home and home care services, giving you the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. You will follow patients over time, make independent clinical assessments and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.Jondal is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. Here, you will live by the Hardangerfjord, surrounded by mountains, with Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, just 19 kilometres away.Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.About the positionAs a nurse in Jondal, you will work with patients with different healthcare and care needs, both in a nursing home and in their own homes.The role gives you a high degree of professional responsibility and the opportunity to follow patients over time, while working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.Your responsibilities will include:    Providing nursing care and following up patients    Clinical observation, assessment and documentation    Medication management and treatment    Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes    Making independent clinical assessments    Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare serviceWho are we looking for?We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.You:    Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country    Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country    Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian    Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work    Hold a valid driving licence    Work well both independently and as part of a team    Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care servicesWe help you prepare for working in NorwayYou do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.We provide:    Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher    Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals    Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation    Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work    Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway    Personal follow-up before, during and after your moveThe language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.What you can expect in Jondal    A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system    Varied work across nursing home and home care services    The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills    Independent professional responsibility    Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    The opportunity to follow patients over time    Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangementsLife between the fjord, mountains and glacierJondal is located in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. It is a small community of around 400 people, situated directly by the Hardangerfjord and surrounded by mountains. Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, is only 19 kilometres away.Nature is part of everyday life here. After work, you can hike in the mountains, kayak or fish on the fjord, or simply enjoy the quiet surroundings. In winter, the area offers excellent opportunities for skiing and other outdoor activities.Despite its small size, Jondal has the essentials you need for everyday life, including a grocery store, places to eat and local cultural and leisure activities. If you are moving with your family, Jondal has both a kindergarten and a school for children from primary through lower secondary level, as well as a library, swimming pool and sports facilities. Odda is around 40 minutes away by car, while Bergen offers a larger city environment and an international airport.Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

jobs.occupation: Permanent nursing positions in Utne, Norway
jobs.description: On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Utne, Western Norway.As a nurse in Utne, you will work across both nursing home and home care services. You will meet patients with different healthcare needs, take independent professional responsibility and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.Utne is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 2.5 hours from Bergen and Bergen International Airport. Located by the Sørfjord, a branch of the famous Hardangerfjord, Utne is surrounded by mountains, fruit orchards and some of Western Norway’s most characteristic scenery.Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.About the positionAs a nurse in Utne, you will have a varied working day and the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. Some patients will be cared for in a nursing home, while others receive care in their own homes.You will work independently and make professional assessments, while also being part of a team and working closely with other healthcare professionals.Your responsibilities will include:    Providing nursing care and following up patients    Clinical observation, assessment and documentation    Medication management and treatment    Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes    Making independent clinical assessments    Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare serviceWho are we looking for?We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.You:    Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country    Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country    Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian    Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work    Hold a valid driving licence    Work well both independently and as part of a team    Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care servicesWe help you prepare for working in NorwayYou do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.We provide:    Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher    Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals    Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation    Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work    Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway    Personal follow-up before, during and after your moveThe language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.What you can expect in Utne    A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system    Varied work across nursing home and home care services    The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills    Independent professional responsibility    Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    The opportunity to follow patients over time    Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangementsLife in the heart of HardangerUtne is located by the Sørfjord in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, surrounded by mountains and fruit orchards. Fruit growing has been part of life here for generations, and the landscape changes with the seasons, from orchards in full bloom in spring to apples, plums, pears and cherries later in the year.Life here is quieter than in a large city, with the fjord and mountains right outside your door. You can spend your free time hiking, exploring the fjord or discovering local farms and producers. Utne also has a strong cultural heritage, including the Hardanger Folk Museum and the historic Utne Hotel.If you are moving with your family, there is a kindergarten in Utne and a primary school with after-school care nearby. Odda, the main town and administrative centre of Ullensvang Municipality, is around 45 minutes away by car and offers a wider range of shops and services. Ferry connections link Utne to both sides of the fjord, making it easy to explore Hardanger and travel onwards towards Voss and Bergen.
